```csharp title="C#"

using System.Text.Json;
using Crawlberg;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };

{
var engineConfig = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CrawlConfig>("{\"retry_codes\":[999]}", ConfigOptions)!;
```
